question: Which group of deities must be fully worshipped in this stage?
premises: A group called the great sixteen is proclaimed.
All deities of this group are included.
The verb paripūjayet prescribes full worship.
inference: One should fully worship all the deities proclaimed as the great sixteen.
uncertainties: The specific identities of the great sixteen deities are not listed here.
plain_english: One should fully worship all the deities proclaimed as the great sixteen.
